title: Backtest Plane — Config + Engine + Metrics
description: Implement simple backtest with explicit cost assumptions and performance metrics. Single-pass simulation, not event-driven.
action: Create synapse/backtest/ module: (1) BacktestConfig dataclass: universe, benchmark, start_date, end_date, rebalance_frequency, transaction_cost_bps (required), slippage_bps (required), position_limit; (2) BacktestEngine: run_backtest(factor_values, returns, config) -> BacktestResult; (3) BacktestMetrics: compute all 8 metrics from contract.
